sloka: धर्मात् अर्थः प्रभवति धर्मात् प्रभवते सुखम् ।धर्मेण लभते सर्वम् धर्म सारम् इदम् जगत् ॥३-९-३०॥
transliteration: dharmāt arthaḥ prabhavati dharmāt prabhavate sukham ।dharmeṇa labhate sarvam dharma sāram idam jagat ॥3-9-30॥

translations.english: You would have been on unlimited source of joy to my fatherinlaw and motherinlaw had you permanently renounced the kingdom for the life of an ascetic.
